nodes.label: Monospace Typography Standard
nodes.rationale: Stopwatch displays and timer numbers must use Montserrat/monospace to prevent visual 'jittering' or layout reflow when numbers increment.

nodes.label: Glassmorphism & Depth System
nodes.rationale: On desktop, full glassmorphism, blur refractions, and fixed sections are rendered. On mobile, glassmorphism falls back to solid background layers to avoid GPU scrolling lag.

nodes.label: Design System Anti-Patterns
nodes.rationale: Prohibits CSS @extend, rogue border radii, transition: all, hardcoded hex colors, inline layout styles, and !important to prevent Vite compilation issues, maintain performance, and keep design token consistency.
